cards.title: 入职第一天的介绍
cards.description_en: A new developer asks a teammate for introductions and repository access.
cards.description_zh: 新入职的开发者请同事介绍团队，并询问如何获得代码仓库的访问权限。
cards.communication_goal: 介绍自己，并提出具体的入职协作请求。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hi, I'm Alex. Could you introduce me to the team?
dialogue.zh: 你好，我是 Alex。你能向我介绍一下团队吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Of course. Your desk is next to mine.
dialogue.zh: 当然。你的办公桌就在我的旁边。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thanks. I'll set up my laptop there. How do I get access to the repository?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我会在那里配置笔记本电脑。我怎样才能获得代码仓库的访问权限？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll send you an invite after introductions.
dialogue.zh: 介绍完大家后，我会给你发送邀请。

cards.scene_prompt: Two adult stick-figure developers greeting each other at a small programmer desk. The newcomer stands at left and gives a friendly small wave; the teammate stands at right and gestures toward the desk in the center. An open laptop sits fully visible on the desk. Draw the complete desk tabletop and legs, and a clearly recognizable open laptop with screen and keyboard, unobstructed. The laptop and desk are the visible learning props.

words.example: Could you introduce me to the team?
words.translation: 你能向我介绍一下团队吗？
words.evidence: 对话明确请求介绍团队；静态招手不证明已经完成介绍，不设动作框。

words.example: Your desk is next to mine.
words.translation: 你的办公桌就在我的旁边。
words.evidence: 场景中的完整办公桌是 desk 的局部指代对象；桌子的分配由对话设定支持。

words.example: I'll set up my laptop there.
words.translation: 我会在那里配置笔记本电脑。
words.evidence: 桌上的打开式笔记本电脑可局部定位；配置行为由对话表达。

words.example: How do I get access to the repository?
words.translation: 我怎样才能获得代码仓库的访问权限？
words.evidence: 权限由对话明确表达，不能从电脑外观判断，不设框。

cards.title: 澄清提交按钮的需求
cards.description_en: A developer and a product manager clarify when a form's submit button should be enabled.
cards.description_zh: 开发者与产品经理确认，表单的提交按钮应当在什么条件下启用。
cards.communication_goal: 提问并复述理解，确认需求条件。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Could you clarify this requirement?
dialogue.zh: 你能澄清一下这项需求吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: The button should stay disabled until all required fields are filled in.
dialogue.zh: 在所有必填项填写完成之前，按钮应保持禁用。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: So the user can submit only after completing the form?
dialogue.zh: 也就是说，用户必须填完表单才能提交，对吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Exactly. Let's check the screen together.
dialogue.zh: 没错。我们一起看一下屏幕。

cards.scene_prompt: Two adult stick-figure coworkers, a developer at left and a product manager at right, discussing one large desktop monitor at center. Both gesture toward its screen. The monitor displays a very simple web form: two empty outlined input fields near the top and ONE distinct rounded rectangular submit button near the lower center. Make the screen and the single button large, unobstructed, and easy to box separately. No text is needed inside the UI. A low simple desktop supports the monitor.

words.example: Could you clarify this requirement?
words.translation: 你能澄清一下这项需求吗？
words.evidence: 通过问答澄清按钮启用条件；人物指屏幕不能单独证明澄清，不设框。

words.example: Could you clarify this requirement?
words.translation: 你能澄清一下这项需求吗？
words.evidence: 本卡需求是对话给出的启用条件，不把整个显示器框作需求。

words.example: The button should stay disabled until all required fields are filled in.
words.translation: 在所有必填项填写完成之前，按钮应保持禁用。
words.evidence: 屏幕表单上的独立圆角按钮是实际局部对象；启用规则由对话支持。

words.example: Let's check the screen together.
words.translation: 我们一起看一下屏幕。
words.evidence: 显示器中呈现表单的屏幕区域可局部框选。

cards.title: 确认任务优先级
cards.description_en: Two developers agree to fix a login issue before updating the page layout.
cards.description_zh: 两名开发者在任务板前确认，先修复登录问题，再处理页面布局。
cards.communication_goal: 明确优先事项、期限和下一步。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Which issue is our top priority?
dialogue.zh: 哪个问题是我们的首要任务？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: The login issue. The deadline for the fix is tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 登录问题。修复的截止时间是明天。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'll take it. Can we move the layout task to next week?
dialogue.zh: 我来处理它。我们能把布局任务移到下周吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes. Let's update the board.
dialogue.zh: 可以。我们更新一下任务板。

cards.scene_prompt: Two adult stick-figure developers standing on opposite sides of one central freestanding task board. The board has three simple vertical columns and a few blank square task cards; one colleague points to the top card while the other holds a small pen and nods. The whole task board including its rectangular frame is clearly visible, unobstructed, centrally placed. No readable writing or numbers on cards. Minimal office setting, no other props.

words.example: Which issue is our top priority?
words.translation: 哪个问题是我们的首要任务？
words.evidence: 对话明确排序任务；不把任务板等同于优先级，不设框。

words.example: The login issue.
words.translation: 登录问题。
words.evidence: 登录问题由对话说明，空白任务卡不能独立证明具体问题。

words.example: The deadline for the fix is tomorrow.
words.translation: 修复的截止时间是明天。
words.evidence: 对话明示明天截止；画面没有表示具体期限的可见对象，不设框。

words.example: Let's update the board.
words.translation: 我们更新一下任务板。
words.evidence: 中央带分栏与任务卡的任务板是实际局部指代对象。

cards.title: 讨论缓存方案的取舍
cards.description_en: Two developers use a diagram to discuss a cache's benefits and maintenance costs.
cards.description_zh: 两名开发者借助示意图，讨论缓存带来的性能收益和维护成本。
cards.communication_goal: 说明方案收益与代价，比较后再决定。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What's the trade-off if we add a cache?
dialogue.zh: 如果增加缓存，需要做什么取舍？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Lower latency, but more work to keep the cached data up to date.
dialogue.zh: 延迟会降低，但保持缓存数据最新需要更多工作。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Could you show that in the diagram?
dialogue.zh: 你能在示意图里说明这一点吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure. Let's compare both options before we decide.
dialogue.zh: 可以。我们比较两种方案后再决定。

cards.scene_prompt: Two adult stick-figure developers discussing a technical diagram on a central whiteboard. One points at the diagram; the other has an open questioning palm. Draw one very simple complete diagram: three empty rectangular boxes connected by arrows, with a second small branching path to suggest two possible routes. The full diagram sits inside the central whiteboard, clear and easy to crop. No labels, code, jargon, numbers, or decorative math. Minimal clean office.

words.example: What's the trade-off if we add a cache?
words.translation: 如果增加缓存，需要做什么取舍？
words.evidence: 对话比较性能与维护代价；不将箭头图当作取舍本身，不设框。

words.example: What's the trade-off if we add a cache?
words.translation: 如果增加缓存，需要做什么取舍？
words.evidence: 缓存是讨论中的逻辑组件；无标识的矩形不证明哪一个是缓存，不设框。

words.example: Lower latency, but more work to keep the cached data up to date.
words.translation: 延迟会降低，但保持缓存数据最新需要更多工作。
words.evidence: 对话说明延迟降低，静态示意图不能展示时间测量，不设框。

words.example: Could you show that in the diagram?
words.translation: 你能在示意图里说明这一点吗？
words.evidence: 白板中的矩形和箭头组成实际可见示意图，可框整体图形而不虚构其技术含义。

cards.title: 请求代码评审
cards.description_en: A developer asks a teammate to review a change and receives a naming suggestion.
cards.description_zh: 开发者请同事评审代码修改，并收到一个让变量命名更清楚的建议。
cards.communication_goal: 请求评审、提出具体建议并确认后续动作。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Could you review the change on my laptop?
dialogue.zh: 你能在我的笔记本电脑上评审这次修改吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure. I suggest renaming this variable so its purpose is clearer.
dialogue.zh: 可以。我建议给这个变量重新命名，让它的用途更清楚。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Good point. I'll update the name and rerun the tests.
dialogue.zh: 有道理。我会修改名称并重新运行测试。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Thanks. I'll take another look when it's ready.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。准备好后，我会再看一次。

cards.scene_prompt: Two adult stick-figure developers seated side by side at a small desk reviewing ONE open laptop. The laptop is centered facing the viewer at a slight angle, with screen and keyboard fully visible. One developer gestures politely with an open hand toward the screen, the other nods with a hand near the keyboard. Only a few abstract horizontal marks on the display suggest an editor; no readable code. Keep the laptop unobstructed and easy to crop. Friendly cooperative posture, minimal office.

words.example: Could you review the change on my laptop?
words.translation: 你能在我的笔记本电脑上评审这次修改吗？
words.evidence: 评审意图与反馈由对话给出，不能仅凭看电脑鉴定评审，不设框。

words.example: Could you review the change on my laptop?
words.translation: 你能在我的笔记本电脑上评审这次修改吗？
words.evidence: 本卡是代码修改而不是物体；抽象编辑器线条不表示具体差异，不设框。

words.example: I suggest renaming this variable so its purpose is clearer.
words.translation: 我建议给这个变量重新命名，让它的用途更清楚。
words.evidence: 建议行为由明确对白支持；不把手势当成建议的充分证据，不设框。

words.example: Could you review the change on my laptop?
words.translation: 你能在我的笔记本电脑上评审这次修改吗？
words.evidence: 桌上的打开式笔记本电脑为实际局部对象。

cards.title: 确认错误复现步骤
cards.description_en: A developer and a tester confirm how to reproduce a form error and document the evidence.
cards.description_zh: 开发者与测试同事确认表单错误的复现步骤，并整理截图等证据。
cards.communication_goal: 确认环境与操作步骤，请求可复查的错误证据。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Can you reproduce this error in your browser?
dialogue.zh: 你能在你的浏览器里复现这个错误吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes. It happens after I submit the form with an empty email field.
dialogue.zh: 能。在邮箱字段为空时提交表单，就会出现。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Could you attach a screenshot and list the steps?
dialogue.zh: 你能附上一张截图，并列出操作步骤吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure. I'll include the expected and actual results too.
dialogue.zh: 可以。我也会写上预期结果和实际结果。

cards.scene_prompt: Two adult stick-figure coworkers debugging at a desk. A central desktop monitor clearly displays ONE browser window with a recognizable top tab and address bar, a simple form, and a small warning triangle. Beside the monitor, on the lower-right part of the desk, place one fully visible printed screenshot sheet, showing a miniature copy of the same browser window and warning triangle. One coworker points toward the monitor and the other toward the printed sheet. Make browser window and screenshot sheet separately recognizable and unobstructed. No readable text, no code, no extra sheets.

words.example: Can you reproduce this error in your browser?
words.translation: 你能在你的浏览器里复现这个错误吗？
words.evidence: 对话明确复现条件；单张静态图不能证明重复运行得到相同结果，不设框。

words.example: Can you reproduce this error in your browser?
words.translation: 你能在你的浏览器里复现这个错误吗？
words.evidence: 具体表单错误与复现条件由对话说明；不把警告符号当作具体错误本身，不设框。

words.example: Can you reproduce this error in your browser?
words.translation: 你能在你的浏览器里复现这个错误吗？
words.evidence: 屏幕上有标签页与地址栏的浏览器窗口为实际局部指代对象；不识别具体品牌。

words.example: Could you attach a screenshot and list the steps?
words.translation: 你能附上一张截图，并列出操作步骤吗？
words.evidence: 桌上的纸张呈现同一浏览器界面的截图副本，由明确场景设定与对白支持；框选完整纸张。

cards.title: 讨论发布回滚
cards.description_en: Two on-call developers coordinate a rollback after a deployment affects users' ability to sign in.
cards.description_zh: 一次发布影响了用户登录，两名值班开发者协商回滚并分工监测恢复情况。
cards.communication_goal: 说明影响、确认回滚与监测分工。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Should we roll back the new deployment?
dialogue.zh: 我们应该回滚这次新发布吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes. The impact is growing—users can't sign in.
dialogue.zh: 应该。影响正在扩大——用户无法登录。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'll watch the monitor while you restore the previous version.
dialogue.zh: 你恢复之前的版本时，我会盯着显示器监测情况。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Okay. I'll record the rollback and confirm when the service is healthy.
dialogue.zh: 好。我会记录这次回滚，并在服务恢复正常后确认。

cards.scene_prompt: Two adult stick-figure on-call developers coordinating calmly at an operations desk. A large standalone monitor at center shows an abstract dashboard with a line chart and one warning triangle. One developer points to the monitor; the other uses a small keyboard. Show the entire monitor with frame and stand clearly visible for a learning crop. Use attentive cooperative poses, not panic. Pure minimalist office, no text, numbers, brands, server racks or dramatic effects.

words.example: I'll record the rollback and confirm when the service is healthy.
words.translation: 我会记录这次回滚，并在服务恢复正常后确认。
words.evidence: 对话明确恢复旧版本；名词 rollback 与动词短语 roll back 分开说明，静态图不证明操作已完成。

words.example: Should we roll back the new deployment?
words.translation: 我们应该回滚这次新发布吗？
words.evidence: 对话明确指一次发布部署；静态图表不能证明部署操作，不设框。

words.example: The impact is growing—users can't sign in.
words.translation: 影响正在扩大——用户无法登录。
words.evidence: 用户登录受影响由对话给出，不从抽象曲线推断影响规模。

words.example: I'll watch the monitor while you restore the previous version.
words.translation: 你恢复之前的版本时，我会盯着显示器监测情况。
words.evidence: 桌上的独立显示器可局部框选；本词条教设备名词，不与 monitor 监测的动词混用。
